modes.name: policy_claim_without_opening
modes.definition: The reply states or cites a policy rule whose document the conversation never opened with get_policy; a search snippet does not count as opened.
modes.boundary: vs unsupported_claim: here a policy document exists and was not read; unsupported_claim asserts something no document or tool supports. A claim supported by a document the agent opened is not this mode, even if another document states it more fully: 'may override' (cw-returns) supports 'the store's window applies' (support-0167, 0092). Applies even when the search snippet shows the whole policy: snippets are the first 300 characters with no truncation marker, so the agent cannot tell a complete snippet from a cut one (support-0177, support-0161; rule chosen 2026-09-27 over judging only what reached the user).
modes.requirement_source: RESP-1, plus a specification revision recorded in the review summary (SPEC.md unchanged): open a policy with get_policy before citing it; a snippet does not count.
modes.confirmed_at_review: 4 positives (0112, 0217, 0092, 0181) and 6 close negatives from batches 1-2; confirmed to run the Part D depth search

modes.name: unnecessary_escalation
modes.definition: The agent escalates a case that the policy and order record already resolve, or offers an exception path no policy describes.
modes.boundary: vs missed_mandatory_escalation: opposite direction; escalating a genuine policy gap (0158) or an inconsistent record (0009) is warranted. ESC-3 reading (decided at review, support-0193): escalation is required for actions/decisions the agent cannot resolve; for information missing from the record, stating the gap (RESP-3) is enough and escalation is allowed, not required.

modes.name: missed_mandatory_escalation
modes.definition: A case SPEC always sends to a human (ESC-1 to ESC-3, e.g. a dispute) ends without an escalate_to_human call.
modes.boundary: vs unnecessary_escalation: opposite direction. ESC-3 reading (decided at review, support-0193): escalation is required for actions/decisions the agent cannot resolve; for information missing from the record, stating the gap (RESP-3) is enough and escalation is allowed, not required.

modes.name: unsupported_claim
modes.definition: The reply states something specific (about Cartwheel, the order, the agent's abilities, or what a human or the escalation will do) that no tool output, opened policy, user message or the agent's own instructions supports.

modes.name: reply_contradicts_retrieved_data
modes.definition: The reply states a value that contradicts a tool result earlier in the same conversation, or that contradicts what a policy the agent opened implies for the retrieved record.
modes.boundary: vs unsupported_claim: the evidence was retrieved and the reply contradicts it. Revised 2026-09-28 at the blind axial pass on support-0213 ("already complete" for $281.25 while the opened cw-refunds says refunds above $100 are queued); earlier definition covered tool results only.
modes.requirement_source: RESP-3 (nearest; no requirement names contradiction -- candidate SPEC revision)
modes.dropped_reason: 2026-10-05: 0 independent positives after its only positive (support-0213) moved to acted_on_inconsistent_record; 0213's root cause is a record that breaks SPEC TOOL-7, not a reply contradicting retrieved data.

modes.name: acted_on_inconsistent_record
modes.definition: The agent relies on an order-record field that contradicts another field of the same record or a policy the agent has in context (opened or seen in a search snippet), without stating the inconsistency.
modes.boundary: vs unsupported_claim: here a retrieved record field supports the claim, but the record itself is wrong; unsupported_claim has no supporting source at all. Revised 2026-10-05: widened from mutually inconsistent fields to fields that break the platform contract, after the refund-status defect (seed marks 418 of 579 refunded orders 'refunded' while the refund is queued) surfaced in support-0213, 0113, 0123. Fix: the tool validates the record and flags defects. Narrowed 2026-10-06 (option B): judged by what the agent saw. get_order returns no refund rows and the system prompt gives no threshold value, so 'refunded' with a queued refund is invisible unless the agent had the $100 rule in context (0213 opened cw-refunds, 0123 saw its snippet). The seed defect itself (seed/generate.py sets status refunded with a queued refund; agent.py marks refunded only on auto-approval) is a data finding for review_summary.md, not this mode. 0083, 0093, 0103, 0113, 0133: same defect, rule not in context -> close negatives.

modes.name: return_deadline_miscalculated
modes.definition: The reply states a last return day that differs from delivery date + window days (inclusive), using the store's window when its policy page sets one.
modes.boundary: vs policy_claim_without_opening: the rule was read; the arithmetic is wrong. Framing stricter than RESP-6 (e.g. 'mailed/postmarked by') is not a failure when it does not change the customer's eligibility (support-0015, past window).
modes.dropped_reason: 2026-10-31: 1 positive in the reviewed sample (support-0072), below the 3 required; dropped to freeze the final taxonomy at 6 modes instead of running a depth search. Not a pool-wide count.

modes.name: answered_out_of_scope_question
modes.definition: For a request SCOPE-2 requires the agent to refuse, the reply holds more than a refusal and a redirect (task content, steps, or an offer to do the task).
modes.boundary: A refusal that redirects to another party is the close negative (0115, 0168). Revised 2026-10-06: the first definition ('answers ... instead of declining') fit only 0232; 0095, 0145, 0214, 0250 refused first, then helped.

modes.name: treated_capped_results_as_complete
modes.definition: A list tool returned exactly its cap and the reply presents the results as the full set or picks a match outside the user's stated criteria.
modes.boundary: vs skipped_order_search: the search ran; its truncation was ignored.
modes.requirement_source: TOOL-6 contract (nearest; no response requirement -- candidate SPEC revision)
modes.dropped_reason: 2026-10-31: 1 positive in the reviewed sample (support-0162), below the 3 required; dropped to freeze the final taxonomy at 6 modes instead of running a depth search. Not a pool-wide count.

modes.name: skipped_order_search
modes.definition: The user describes an order by product and the agent answers without calling find_order although its role may.
modes.boundary: vs treated_capped_results_as_complete: no search ran at all.
modes.requirement_source: TOOL-6 contract, AUTH-1 (nearest -- candidate SPEC revision)
modes.dropped_reason: 2026-10-05: 2 positives in the whole 250-scenario pool (support-0207, support-0243; 0195 is a close negative), below the 3 required. Support sessions skipped find_order in 2 of 7 find_order scenarios vs 0 of 19 for shoppers and merchants; consistent with the find_order docstring 'Search your orders' misleading support staff (unverified, n=7).
